**Source of truth inventory** (task rule: derive from `src/main.py` `include_router` calls + router-file decorators, never from the integration guide):

```bash
# 1) Mounted routers (names, prefixes, tags)

# 2) Confirm each router file actually declares routes (not just imported)
```

**GAP-021 — structure tree `src/routers/` → `src/api/`** (both the tree dir and the prose note):

```diff
 src/
 ├── main.py          # FastAPI app entrypoint
-├── routers/         # feature routers (auth, users)
+├── api/             # feature routers (mounted in src/main.py)
 │   ├── auth.py
+│   ├── datasets.py
+│   ├── dataset_versions.py
+│   ├── ... (all 15 router files)
 │   └── users.py
 ...
-> Note: feature routers are mounted from `src/routers/` (see `src/main.py`).
+> Note: feature routers are mounted from `src/api/` (see `src/main.py`).
```

**GAP-022 — API overview table expanded from 2 → 15 rows** (13 missing feature routers added). Table generated programmatically from `src/main.py` so it cannot drift: regex `include_router\((\w+)\.router,\s*prefix="([^"]+)",\s*tags=\["([^"]+)"\]\)` → one row per router (`Router | Prefix | Tags | Description`), descriptions merged from a small static map. Added rows: `sessions, tokens, datasets, dataset_versions, datapoints, labels, label_runs, projects, teams, exports, imports, health, metrics`.

**GAP-024 — venv setup before `make test-fast`**:

```markdown
### Prerequisites
$ python -m venv .venv
$ source .venv/bin/activate   # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
$ pip install -e ".[dev]"

### Fast tests
$ make test-fast
```

**One `docs:` commit for all three** (tick #183), board completion fired once after push:

```bash
git add README.md
git commit -m "docs(readme): fix GAP-021/022/024 router inventory, tree path, and test env setup (tick #183)"
```
